changeSummary: Zero Trust runtime decision prompt in the v20 dictionary format (W3-1 to W3-19, TO-1 to TO-5, LU-1 to LU-4, R4-T, R4-B9 and the P3 extra work; the 2026.10.14-v20.14 manifest lists them), with the P4 system text: the minimum action rules the host turned on, each naming its floor, P1 and P2 a challenge and P3 a review because a verified user does not supply a missing record (W4-4, N-P3-1); the boundaries and evidence rules on prompt facts only, the BLOCK boundary naming what is observed and a repeat, a new target or a large volume no risk by itself (N-RULE-1, N-WORD-1, N-FRIC-1); the output contract v3 block with the meaning and the cited line of every reason code, MATERIAL_MISSING_EVIDENCE citing the ID the UNKNOWN line gives each missing fact (W4-2, N-UID-1); no fixed reason sentences (W4-3). An approval without a decision time says what was not checked (N-WORD-1). The response checker falls back to the contract's action after a failed retry (N-OUT-1, W4-5) and checks the boundaries, the reason claims and the reason codes on the facts the prompt was drawn from (W4-8). The golden render draws the baseline the sealed prompts state (N-GOLD-1). The budget profiles fitted to these prompts the TO-5 way.
